title: Small vessels kept off Northern Samar coasts due to Rosal

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — The Philippine Coast Guard has temporarily suspended voyages of vessels with a gross tonnage of 250 and below along the Northern Samar coast due to strong to gale-force winds from Super Typhoon Rosal (international name: Champi). In an advisory issued on Wednesday, the Coast Guard said the suspension covers vessels operating in the municipalities of Laoang, Palapag, Pambujan, Mondragon and San Roque. The Coast Guard implemented the measure after the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) issued Gale Warning No. 2 by 5 a.m. on Wednesday.
